sanjay: Quick snapshot: ran a small regional microbench across L4, T4, A10G for embeddings + small-chat. Summary below (EU-West / US-West / APAC). Results are single-run but show consistent patterns. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

marta: Nice, did you include int8 runs? any quality checks?

dmitri: yes — ran FP16, dynamic INT8 (per-tensor), and per-channel INT8. Here's the compact output:
```
Workload    GPU   batch  p50(ms) p95(ms) throughput(req/s)  cost/1M tok
embeds      L4    64     9       18      7200               $12
embeds      A10G  128    7       15     15000               $9
embeds      T4    64     12      28      5600               $7.5
small-chat  L4    8     30      85      220                $22
small-chat  A10G  16    26      70      440                $18
small-chat  T4    4     40     110      120                $9
notes: L4 uses fused/flash-attn kernels, A10G uses optimized triton+cutlass mix, T4 falls back to legacy cutlass kernels
```

carla: Embedding quality note — per-channel INT8 had a ~0.8% avg cosine drop on our QA set for short queries (n=2-8 tokens). FP16 and dynamic int8 were within noise.

sanjay: Good catch. For embeddings pipeline we should default to FP16 on L4/A10G unless we need cost cut; allow per-channel INT8 as opt-in with QA guardrails.

eva: For capacity planning, what's your nodes/1k rps estimate for small-chat (avg 128 tokens)?

sanjay: Rough numbers:
- L4: 1 r4 node (4x L4) ~ 550 rps for small-chat 128 tokens => ~2 nodes per 1k rps
- A10G: 1 node (8x A10G) ~ 1800 rps => ~1 node per 1k rps (more efficient packing)
- T4: 1 rack of T4s ~ 300 rps => ~3-4 nodes per 1k rps
These depend on batching and KV-cache hit rates; assume 70% cache hit.

ben: Can we get region breakdowns? EU-West saw +15% p95 on T4 vs US-West during peak.

dmitri: EU-West T4 had higher tail due to older kernel build and slower PCIe gen. A10G consistent across regions. L4 variability is low but throughput drops slightly in APAC with smaller pack sizes.

perf-bot: perf-sweep complete: results uploaded to s3://redwood-perf/2770012345/snapshot.csv — run_id=2770012345 :white_check_mark:

marta: Follow-up action: 1) disable per-channel INT8 by default for embeddings 2) schedule canary with user prompt set + eval harness 3) retest EU-West T4 kernel builds

sanjay: Agreed. I'll open a follow-up runbook and assign owners. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
